method.method_draft: From the image, trace every non-hydrogen atom-to-atom connection in the main structure. Count R1–carbonyl carbon, carbonyl C=O on the left, carbonyl carbon–N, N–O, O–right carbonyl carbon, right carbonyl C=O, and right carbonyl carbon–R2. Do not count N–H or O–H because they involve hydrogen, and do not count the curved arrows. The total is 7.
